items.claim: Project establishes unified three-file continuity protocol in docs/continuity/ (CODE_INDEX.md, CURRENT_STATE.md, STATUS_LEDGER.md) fully consolidating legacy tracking documents
items.result: Three structured continuity documents authored with concise length budgets; AGENTS.md updated to enforce reading order
items.limitations: Continuity protocol provides single source of truth for cross-session AI state; detailed experiment logs continue to reside in research/evidence/

items.claim: Research scope is frozen to three training classes (authentic, fully_generated, ai_edited), with uncertain defined strictly as post-calibration decision state and localization as secondary objective
items.result: Core tasks partitioned into primary classification/calibration and secondary mask-based localization; heatmap from patch scores marked as exploratory
items.limitations: Localization accuracy remains unverified until ground-truth mask evaluation is performed on real test data

items.claim: Four testable research questions (RQ1-RQ4) and metric hierarchy (primary Macro-F1/Balanced Accuracy, calibration, robustness, browser) are formally locked
items.result: Comprehensive evaluation framework and 4 research questions formally codified in docs/EVALUATION.md and docs/RESEARCH_PLAN.md with pre-registered verification protocols
items.limitations: Hypothesis evaluation requires training on authorized real datasets in Phase 4

items.claim: TGIF and TGIF2 official repository and Nextcloud storage shares audited: TGIF (65.4 GB across 6 subfolders), TGIF2-FLUX (110 GB), TGIF2-random (73 GB); independent folder downloads supported
items.result: Nextcloud shares inspected; exact component sizes recorded; subfolder-level archive downloading verified (e.g. masks at 40.4 MB, orig at 6.8 GB)
items.limitations: Inspection performed via browser metadata querying; zero content bytes downloaded

items.claim: TGIF dataset is officially licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0; authentic images are CC BY 4.0 (MS-COCO); derivative weights status is unclear and prohibited from production by project policy
items.result: TGIF registered under research-only track with CC BY-SA 4.0, derivativeWeights: unclear, productionPromotion: prohibited-by-project-policy
items.limitations: Share-Alike condition of CC BY-SA 4.0 may attach to trained checkpoints; conservative policy confines usage to research track

items.claim: Dataset-source shortcut risk (model learning dataset artifacts instead of AI traces) is formally identified with mandatory group splitting and cross-dataset evaluation controls
items.result: Research-data matrix documents shortcut risks per dataset; mandates source-held-out splits and matched authentic-forged pairs
items.limitations: Heuristic control; true robustness against shortcut learning requires empirical cross-dataset validation

items.claim: Three-tier pilot pathways (A: Pipeline smoke, B: Exploratory three-class, C: Confirmatory benchmark) are formulated with exact resource budgets; Pilot B recommended for thesis resources
items.result: Pilot B balanced 3-class proposal specified (~3,000 samples, ~15 GB download, ~18 GB extracted, >=35 GB disk); requires explicit user approval before execution
items.limitations: Proposal only; zero external bytes downloaded in Phase 4A.2
